questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 31, 42, 53, 64, 75, 89, 97
questions.why: In the correct series each term adds 11, so 89 should be 86. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statements: No chairs are tables. All tables are desks. Conclusions: I. All chairs are desks. II. Some desks are not chairs.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I need not be true, II must be true. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Parents have complained of bullying during recess. Which situation should the recess aides report to the principal?
opts: Four girls surround another and hold her backpack
Two boys argue over a basketball score
Three boys play a banned video game
questions.why: Only B shows a group intimidating one child. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2024.

questions.q: Statements: All rivers are lakes. No lakes are ponds. Conclusions: I. Some rivers are ponds. II. All rivers are ponds.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I need not be true, II need not be true. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statement: "The government should immediately tighten regulation of pharmaceutical advertising to protect public health." Which assumption is inherent?
opts: Such advertising now misleads the public or poses a health risk
Regulation is the only way to protect public health
The government has all the resources needed
Public health is deteriorating because of such advertising
questions.why: The call for urgent regulation presumes a present risk. B and D are too strong. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: Meera is the brother of Rahul. Rekha is the father of Meera. Sita is the brother of Priya. Priya is the daughter of Rahul. Who is the uncle of Sita?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Meera. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: At what time between 3 and 4 o’clock will the hands of a clock be at right angles (after 3:00)?
questions.why: 5.5M − 90 = 90, so M = 32 8/11: about 3:32. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2026.

questions.q: Looking at a portrait, Arun said, 'I have no brother or sister, but this man's father is my father's son.' Whose portrait is it?
questions.why: With no brother, 'my father's son' is Arun himself. So Arun is the father of the man in the portrait.

questions.q: If NURSING is written as OWUWNTN in a certain code, how is DOCTOR written in that code?
questions.why: In the code the 1st letter moves 1 place, the 2nd 2 places, the 3rd 3 places, and so on: DOCTOR → EQFXTX. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In how many different ways can the letters of the word MEDICINE be arranged?
questions.why: 8 letters with repeats: 8! ÷ 2! ÷ 2! = 10080. GPSC-style practice item.
